name: Petrified
summary: Turned to stone: Incapacitated, Speed 0, fails Str and Dex saves, Resistance to all damage.
text: You and the nonmagical things you wear and carry turn into an inanimate substance, usually stone; your weight is multiplied by ten and you stop aging. You have the Incapacitated condition, your Speed is 0 and can't increase, attack rolls against you have Advantage, and you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. You have Resistance to all damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition.
